jobs.title: AI Business Unit Leader - Build our new B2B SaaS Business
jobs.description:
Description

The opportunity

Aspire Software, an operating group of Valsoft Corporation, acquires, builds, and grows vertical market software companies around the world. Each brand operates with entrepreneurial autonomy while benefiting from shared expertise, leadership, and collaboration across our global portfolio.

Aspire Software is launching a new AI-driven B2B SaaS venture and is seeking an AI Lead to build and lead it from day one. We partner with vertical market software businesses to identify high-impact opportunities where AI can unlock significant customer value. This new venture will focus on building a developer-first, AI-enabled SaaS platform, designed to integrate seamlessly into existing workflows and scale through strong product adoption.

The market opportunity is proven, fragmented, and ready for transformation. As AI Lead, you will shape the product vision, drive go-to-market execution, build the founding team, and establish market leadership - backed by Aspire and Valsoft’s capital, infrastructure, and global operating expertise.

What You'll Be Doing 

Lead a new B2B SaaS business built around AI and platform innovation in a vertical software market 
Develop and execute a scalable go-to-market strategy: identify early adopters, iterate on positioning, and close first customers 
Define product and market strategy, with a strong focus on developer experience, adoption, and scalability
Build a milestone-based plan, allocate budget, and raise capital with our support 
Assemble a high-performing team to execute across product, tech, sales, and operations 
Partner closely with technical leaders to ensure high-quality APIs, SDKs, documentation, and integration workflows
Own and operate the business with full autonomy  

What You Bring 

A founder mindset: You’re motivated by building from scratch and fully owning the journey 
3+ years of experience building or operating AI software, API or SDK based platforms with leadership experience (e.g. Product lead, Startup Founder, or Sales/Operations lead) 
Demonstrated success in building early-stage ventures or leading 0→1 product launches, with bachelor in relevant field  
Strong understanding of developer-first products, including documentation, onboarding, reliability, and versioning
Grit and resourcefulness with proven success of operating without a playbook  
Commercial mindset with exposure to pricing, packaging, GTM execution, and customer adoption
Excellent communication skills across technical and business domains
Ability to drive the overall company vision, culture, and performance 

What You’ll Own 

P&L responsibility: You’ll run the company day-to-day and long-term 
Equity stake: You’ll be a significant shareholder in the business you help create 
Product and market vision: You’ll lead strategy, execution, and team alignment 
Customer outcomes: You’ll focus relentlessly on value creation for users 

How To Apply  

Interested? Send your resume and a brief note about why you're excited about this opportunity. We'd love to see:  

Your track record building or scaling businesses  
Examples of go-to-market strategies you've developed and executed  
Anything that demonstrates your ability to build from scratch and drive results 

About Valsoft 

Established in Canada in 2015, Valsoft Corporation acquires, operates, and scales vertical market software companies around the world. Through our AI Ventures program, we’re building a new generation of AI-native businesses designed to transform specific industries. Each venture operates as an independent startup — with speed, ownership, and autonomy, backed by Valsoft’s global infrastructure and capital.

L'opportunité

Aspire Software, une division de Valsoft Corporation, acquiert, développe et fait croître des entreprises de logiciels spécialisées dans des marchés verticaux à travers le monde. Chaque marque bénéficie d'une autonomie entrepreneuriale tout en profitant de l'expertise, du leadership et de la collaboration partagés au sein de notre portefeuille mondial.

Aspire Software lance une nouvelle plateforme SaaS B2B basée sur l'IA et recherche un Responsable IA pour la développer et la piloter dès son lancement. Nous collaborons avec des entreprises de logiciels spécialisées dans des marchés verticaux afin d'identifier les opportunités à fort impact où l'IA peut générer une valeur client significative. Cette nouvelle plateforme se concentrera sur la création d'une plateforme SaaS centrée sur les développeurs et intégrant l'IA, conçue pour s'intégrer facilement aux flux de travail existants et évoluer grâce à une forte adoption du produit.

Le marché est porteur, fragmenté et mûr pour la transformation. En tant que Responsable IA, vous définirez la vision produit, piloterez la stratégie de commercialisation, constituerez l'équipe fondatrice et établirez le leadership sur le marché, soutenu par le capital, l'infrastructure et l'expertise opérationnelle mondiale d'Aspire et de Valsoft.

Vos Missions

Piloter une nouvelle activité SaaS B2B axée sur l'IA et l'innovation de plateforme au sein d'un marché vertical du logiciel.
Développer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de commercialisation évolutive : identifier les premiers utilisateurs, optimiser le positionnement et conclure les premiers contrats.
Définir la stratégie produit et marché, en mettant l'accent sur l'expérience développeur, l'adoption et l'évolutivité.
Élaborer un plan par étapes, allouer le budget et lever des fonds avec notre soutien.
Constituer une équipe performante pour assurer la mise en œuvre des projets produit, technique, commercial et opérationnel.
Collaborer étroitement avec les responsables techniques pour garantir la qualité des API, des SDK, de la documentation et des flux d'intégration.
Gérer l'activité en toute autonomie.

Votre Profil

Plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans la conception ou l'exploitation de logiciels d'IA, de plateformes API ou SDK, avec une expérience en management (par exemple : chef de produit, fondateur de startup ou responsable commercial/opérations).
Expérience réussie dans la création d'entreprises en phase de démarrage ou le lancement de produits (de 0 à 1), avec un diplôme de niveau bac+3/4. Expérience pertinente
Solide compréhension des produits destinés aux développeurs, notamment en matière de documentation, d'intégration, de fiabilité et de gestion des versions
Esprit entrepreneurial : vous êtes motivé(e) par la création d'un produit à partir de zéro et souhaitez en assumer pleinement la responsabilité
Persévérance et ingéniosité, avec une expérience réussie de la gestion de projets sans plan préétabli
Sens commercial et expérience en matière de tarification, de packaging, de stratégie de mise sur le marché et d'adoption par les clients
Excellentes compétences en communication, tant sur le plan technique que commercial
Capacité à piloter la vision, la culture et la performance globales de l'entreprise

Vos responsabilités

Gestion du compte de résultat : vous assurerez la gestion quotidienne et stratégique de l'entreprise
Participation au capital : vous serez un actionnaire important de l'entreprise que vous contribuerez à créer
Vision produit et marché : vous piloterez la stratégie, son exécution et la coordination des équipes
Satisfaction client : vous vous concentrerez sans relâche sur la création de valeur pour les utilisateurs

Comment postuler

Intéressé(e) ? Envoyez Votre CV Et Une Brève Lettre De Motivation Expliquant Votre Intérêt Pour Cette Opportunité. Nous Serions Ravis De Voir 

Votre expérience en matière de création ou de développement d'entreprises
Des exemples de stratégies de commercialisation que vous avez élaborées et mises en œuvre
Tout élément démontrant votre capacité à bâtir une entreprise à partir de zéro et à obtenir des résultats concrets

À propos de Valsoft 

Valsoft Corporation acquiert, exploite et développe des entreprises de logiciels spécialisés à travers le monde. Par le biais de notre programme AI Ventures, nous bâtissons une nouvelle génération d'entreprises nativement IA conçues pour transformer des secteurs spécifiques. Chaque entreprise en démarrage opère de manière indépendante — avec rapidité, autonomie et responsabilisation, soutenue par l'infrastructure mondiale et le capital de Valsoft.

jobs.title: Director of Finance, Contract
jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Director of Finance, Contract leads the day-to-day operations of the Finance function — financial planning & analysis, accounting, treasury, reporting, and controls — ensuring the organization's financial operations are accurate, timely, and disciplined. This role translates the CFO's financial strategy into operational execution and partners closely with the Director, PMO to ensure enterprise programs are properly resourced, tracked, and financially governed.

Reporting to the CFO, the Director, Finance partners with the Director, PMO; Director, Innovation; and Director, Human Resources as part of the CFO's core leadership team, ensuring finance, technology, people, and program delivery function as a coherent, well-run “operating system” for the business.

Duration: This is a 14-month maternity leave contract, running from February 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027.

WalterFedy is growing! For outstanding talent, this role has real potential to be extended. It's an opportunity to make an immediate impact and build a long-term future with our Finance team.

Accountabilities / Responsibilities

Client Delivery

This role's “clients” are primarily internal: business/practice line leaders who rely on Finance for accurate reporting, forecasting, and decision support. The role also maintains day-to-day external relationships (auditors, lenders, insurers), escalating strategic matters to the CFO.

Serve as the primary finance business partner to practice/business line leaders on budgeting, forecasting, utilization, margin, and project financial performance.
Maintain strong day-to-day working relationships with auditors, banking partners, and insurers, escalating strategic matters to the CFO.
Support practice leaders with accurate, timely financial data to inform pricing, resourcing, and project decisions.

Financial Delivery

Lead day-to-day financial planning & analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting for the organization.
Own the accounting function: general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, payroll coordination, and month-end/year-end close.
Lead treasury operations, cash flow management, and banking relationships.
Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of financial statements and internal management reporting.
Maintain strong internal controls and support audit readiness and regulatory compliance.
Monitor utilization, realization, backlog, and project margin performance, escalating trends to the CFO.

Business Processes

Own and continuously improve core finance processes, systems, and reporting tools (ERP, financial reporting/BI tools).
Automation & AI enablement: Partner with the Director, Innovation on finance system upgrades, automation of manual finance processes, and adoption of AI-enabled tools for forecasting, reporting, or analysis.
Develop and maintain financial policies, procedures, and delegation of authority frameworks.
Support enterprise governance by ensuring enterprise program budgets and business cases meet finance standards before approval, in partnership with the Director, PMO.

Leadership and Culture

Lead, coach, and develop the Finance team, building depth and succession within the function.
Partner with the Director, Human Resources on workforce planning, compensation benchmarking, and headcount/capacity planning from a financial lens.
Act as a trusted, approachable finance partner to non-finance leaders, building financial literacy across the organization.
Model financial discipline and transparency, reinforcing a culture of accountability.
Support the CFO on special projects, board materials, and executive-level financial analysis as needed.

Skills / Competencies

Strategic Vision & Long-Range Planning: Finance function strategist; translates enterprise financial strategy into operational plans.
Financial Acumen & Capital Allocation: Deep technical expertise in accounting, treasury, and financial reporting.
Operational Excellence, Delivery & Resource Management: Finance operations, reporting, and controls excellence.
People Leadership & Talent Development: Finance team builder and developer.
Client Leadership & External Relationships: Day-to-day auditor, lender, and insurer relationship management.
Change Leadership: Finance process and systems change lead; partners with the Director, PMO on enterprise program financial governance.
Innovation/Continuous Improvement: Champions automation of finance processes and adoption of AI-enabled tools.
Commercial Acumen, Client Growth & Market Development: Supports pricing, fee models, and business case analysis.
Risk Management & Governance: Internal controls and audit-readiness specialist.
Communication & Executive Presence: Trusted finance advisor to non-finance leaders.
Technical / Practice Leadership: Finance and accounting subject matter expert.
Culture Building & Organizational Health: Champions financial discipline and transparency.
Cross-Functional Integration: Finance partner to the Director, PMO, Director, Human Resources, and Director, Innovation on enterprise initiatives.

Qualifications

University degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
Active CPA (or equivalent professional accounting designation) required.
Minimum 7 years of progressive finance experience, including people leadership, ideally within a professional services, or engineering/architecture , or similarly project-based organization.
Demonstrated experience in financial planning & analysis, treasury, and controls.
Experience in a growth-stage or scaling organization is an asset.

Life at WalterFedy

As a national, innovative, multi-discipline design and construction collective, our ambition goes beyond great design - we are here to enhance the world around us. We need a team of agile, ambitious, and big-picture thinkers who share our drive to harness our collective talents to do something bigger.

Our team is made up of the industry's best. We share a common commitment to questioning the ordinary, infusing everything we do with creativity, and challenging our industry to redefine what’s possible.

Join us as we move past working for a living, and toward building better communities with smart, influential design.

How To Apply

Please apply with your resume and use the link at the top of this page. You will be redirected to our internal application platform.  

WalterFedy strives to create a culture of inclusivity and diversity. We strongly encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including those from groups traditionally underrepresented in the workforce. We are committed to equal opportunity hiring practice and will not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, creed, national origin, citizenship, status, age, sex, gender identity/expression, marital or domestic partnership status, or disability.  

Should you require an accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact hr@walterfedy.com or call 519-576-2150.  

Thank you for your interest in WalterFedy!  

Please note that we utilize AI-powered tools to enhance our recruitment process. These tools assist us in managing applications efficiently and ensuring a fair evaluation of all candidates. Rest assured, every application is reviewed by our recruitment team, and AI is used to support, not replace, our human decision-making.
